content:
github-actions[bot] opened issue #15340:

humantime is unmaintained

Details
Status unmaintained
Package humantime
Version 2.1.0
URL https://github.com/chronotope/chrono/issues/1768
Date 2026-09-14

Because chrono is now unmaintained and humantime wraps chrono, it is also unmaintained; all
versions are affected.

See advisory page for additional details.

pchickey commented on issue #15340:

Our direct dependency that pulls this in is file-per-thread-logger which @bnjbvr last made a release of in June 2023.

after cargo update env_logger@0.11.5 the tree looks like:

[p.hickey@KVKD0WG7VF:src/wasmtime]% cargo tree -i humantime
humantime v2.1.0
└── env_logger v0.10.2
    └── file-per-thread-logger v0.2.0
        ├── cranelift-filetests v0.0.0 (/Users/p.hickey/src/wasmtime/cranelift/filetests)
        │   [dev-dependencies]
        │   └── wasmtime-cli v52.0.0-dev (/Users/p.hickey/src/wasmtime)
        └── wasmtime-cli-flags v52.0.0-dev (/Users/p.hickey/src/wasmtime/crates/cli-flags)
            ├── wasmtime-cli v52.0.0-dev (/Users/p.hickey/src/wasmtime)
            └── wasmtime-test-util v52.0.0-dev (/Users/p.hickey/src/wasmtime/crates/test-util)
                [dev-dependencies]
                └── wasmtime-cli v52.0.0-dev (/Users/p.hickey/src/wasmtime)

pchickey edited a comment on issue #15340:

We have two deps that pull this in transitively. env_logger 0.11.5 is trivially updatable to 0.11.10 to get rid of the humantime dep.

file-per-thread-logger 0.2.0 which @bnjbvr last made a release of in June 2023 also pulls this in via env_logger 0.10.2. I asked Ben if he can please make a new crates.io release here: https://github.com/bnjbvr/file-per-thread-logger/issues/96

after cargo update env_logger@0.11.5 the tree looks like:

[p.hickey@KVKD0WG7VF:src/wasmtime]% cargo tree -i humantime
humantime v2.1.0
└── env_logger v0.10.2
